context_for_next_testing_agent: Modal positioning fix (iter 215d6.2) is COMPLETE and VERIFIED. All custom modals/drawers in /memberships now render correctly on mobile with Save/Cancel buttons visible within the 844px viewport. The fix involved: (1) removing transform from .module-fade-in CSS animation, (2) wrapping all custom modals with React.createPortal to document.body.

rca_of_the_issue.problem: Modal Save/Cancel buttons were hidden off-screen on mobile (390x844) in iteration 215d6.1
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: CSS transform: translateY() on .module-fade-in animation created a new containing block for position:fixed descendants, causing modals to size to <main>'s scroll height instead of viewport
fix_applied: 1. Changed .module-fade-in animation to opacity-only (removed transform) in App.css
2. Wrapped ModalShell, MemberEditDrawer, InstructorRosterView drawer, and PromoEditorModal with React.createPortal rendering into document.body
rca_of_the_issue.verification: All modals now have Save/Cancel buttons within viewport (Y < 844px on mobile, Y < 900px on desktop)

mobile_app_readiness_note: The GymAxis Memberships console is now mobile-ready. All modal dialogs and drawers (Add Member, New Plan, New Instructor, New Promo Code, Member Edit) position correctly on mobile devices with action buttons (Save/Cancel) always visible within the viewport. The FloatingAssistant correctly hides when modals are open to avoid UI overlap.
